response.sql: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_price_per_day FROM film WHERE rental_rate IS NOT NULL AND rental_duration IS NOT NULL AND rental_duration > 0 GROUP BY rating), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_price_per_day) AS overall_avg FROM rating_averages), above_average_ratings AS (SELECT ra.avg_price_per_day FROM rating_averages ra CROSS JOIN overall_average oa WHERE ra.avg_price_per_day > oa.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_price_per_day) AS avg_per_day_price, AVG(avg_price_per_day) - (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall_average) AS avg_above_average FROM above_average_ratings
